What was once experimental is now rapidly becoming real. Advances in AI, combined with breakthroughs in sensing and motion control, are enabling a new generation of robots designed to operate in human environments. As this market develops, success will depend on one critical factor: the ability to deliver safe, precise, reliable, and scalable subsystems. That is where we are focused. Start early, scale over time Humanoid platforms are still in early development, but design decisions made today will shape the market for years to come. Our strategy is simple: engage early, secure meaningful positions within emerging architectures, and grow with the platform as it matures. Recent design wins in Europe reflect this approach. While initial volumes are limited, they establish a foundation for long-term participation as production scales. Integration is the next frontier Humanoid robots require seamless integration across multiple technologies: Motion control systems that deliver power, safety and precision Sensing solutions that enable safe human interaction Intelligent subsystems that support adaptive, real-time behavior We are investing in platforms that bring these elements together, helping developers reduce complexity while improving performance. Global collaboration matters Robotics innovation is inherently global. Engineering teams often span continents, and successful engagement requires coordination across regions. Our teams are working together across geographies to support these complex development environments and ensure consistent execution and faster progress. Innovation through partnership The most advanced robotics companies are not just adopters of technology, they are pushing boundaries. By working closely with these innovators , we gain valuable insights that help us refine our own platforms and establish strategic partnerships to grow faster in the market. These partnerships accelerate development on both sides, and strengthen our position with the leading humanoid OEMs. Looking ahead Humanoid robotics is still early, but the trajectory is clear. As adoption grows, demand for high-performance motion and sensing solutions will increase significantly. We are positioning ourselves through focused investment, early engagement, and strong partnerships to scale with this market. The market is early, but the direction is clear.
